title: Firmware Module Automation & Cloud CDN Synchronization
description: Introduces one-click installation and uninstallation of the Scyan ZMK display module directly into your keyboard repository. Enhances repository caching with aggressive CDN bypasses for instant GitHub synchronization.
highlights: 1-Click automated install and clean uninstall for the scyan-zmk-module directly in zmk-config
All studio commits now carry the standard [Scyan Studio] prefix
Aggressive GitHub API & CDN cache-busting to prevent stale branch conflict errors
Session storage and local layout cache automated cleanup upon module removal

Ensure immediate reactivity on local storage state transitions

title: GIF Animation Importer & Multi-Frame Slicing Engine
description: A major upgrade to the asset pipeline adding full support for animated GIFs. Imported frames are automatically packed into the Symbols Atlas, sliced into groups, and rendered live with the new Loop Animation widget.
highlights: Native client-side GIF parser with 1bpp dithering and transparent background handling
Loop Animation widget with runtime frame delay and dynamic frame-count scaling
Interactive crop bounding box with drag handles for fast sprite extraction
Automatic grouping and naming for multi-frame animation sequences

changes: Preserve full frame count for WIDGET_TYPE_LOOP in cHeaderParser
Sync Kconfig idle timeout with animation widget preferences
Sanitize slice IDs to strictly valid C identifier names
Expand sprite_slice offset types to uint16_t for large atlases
Emit explicit left/right idle screen toggle defines in asymmetric mode

title: Dual-Atlas Studio Foundation & Visual Layout Compiler
description: The initial release of Scyan ZMK Studio. Features an infinite 2-Atlas pixel editor (Symbols + Font), dynamic layout block composition for left/right OLED displays, interactive oscilloscope WPM chart, Bongo Cat widget, and live GitHub synchronization.
highlights: Dual 1bpp Atlases (Font + Symbols) with infinite canvas and real-time pixel editing
Dynamic block system with Active and Idle display states for split keyboards
Full Corne 5x3 keyboard hardware simulator with Colemak & QWERTY scan-code typing
Oscilloscope heartbeat WPM chart with real-time waveform decay
Automated single-source-of-truth C header compilation (scyan_assets.h) with lossless metadata round-trip

changes: Unify asset loading around scyan_assets.install.h templates
Fix natural size calculation for WPM widget in symbol and font modes
Accurate font ink extent measurements for bounding boxes and export
